text:
marta (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we’re doing a handwritten thank-you postcard assembly tied to this quarter's micro-spot awards. Goal: mail out 150 notes Friday. Need volunteers for assembly, postage runs, and a final cleaned recipient CSV by Thu 6pm. :heart:

amy.yang: Love this. I can do an hour Fri morning. What’s the location?

marta (People Ops): Thanks Amy — lobby meeting room B at 10am. We’ll have a station for writing, one for envelope stuffing, and one for postage/labeling.

samir (Product): Do we want to include a tiny spot-award sticker or a printed certificate in each envelope?

natalie (Office Ops): We have 150 small 'micro-win' stickers in storage. I can bring them. Also can run to the post office at 11:30 if someone volunteers to cover the assembly desk while I'm out.

devin (Eng): I can cover the postage run. Also happy to help fold cards.

marta (People Ops): Perfect. Volunteer slots so far: Amy 10–11, Devin 10–12, Samir 10–11, Natalie leads logistics. Still need 4 more folks for 10–11 and 2 people for label/CSV QA by Thu EOD.

amy.yang: tagging a few folks who might be around — @olivia, @jamesb (can you both help?)

recognition-bot: reminder: micro-spot award nominations closed 48 hours ago. 162 nominations received.

marta (People Ops): Quick note on the CSV: we need columns exactly named recipient_name, email, office_location, award_reason (short), and nominator. Please remove duplicates and prefer office address for physical mail. Put 'REMOTE' in office_location if remote and we have consent for home address mailing.

samir (Product): Small question — are we including the mini spot-award card in envelopes only for nominees who accepted physical mail? We had ~30 remote without address consent.

marta (People Ops): Good call. We will only mail to folks with consent. For the remote no-address group we'll send an e-card and a Slack shoutout. I'll compile two lists: Mail-OK and e-card-only. Need final Mail-OK CSV by Thu 6pm.

natalie (Office Ops): Budget check: postage + stickers + envelopes = est $120. Do we have approval?

marta (People Ops): Approved under Q2 culture micro-budget. Mark center_cost_code: CULT-2026. Natalie, can you expense receipts and drop the cost code in Concur?

natalie (Office Ops): Will do.

devin (Eng): For the label station I can bring a laptop and run a small script to print address labels. Anyone have the template?

marta (People Ops): I uploaded a label template to the shared drive: `PeopleOps/recognition/label-template.csv` — please use it as-is. Label printer is in supply closet #2.

samir (Product): Logistics Q: how long should volunteers plan to stay?

marta (People Ops): Aim for 60–90 minutes. We’ll have routing so people can drop in for a 30m shift if needed.

amy.yang: I can grab a thermos of coffee and a couple of snack boxes for volunteers. :coffee:

marta (People Ops): Amazing thank you. Final call: if you want to volunteer, react with :raised_hand: here and put your free window for Fri 10–12. Also DM me if you have questions about recipient consent.

devin (Eng): :raised_hand: available 10–11 and can cover postage run at 11:30.

samir (Product): :raised_hand: 10–11.

amy.yang: :raised_hand: 10–10:30.

marta (People Ops): Awesome — we have 5 confirmed. Need 4 more. I'll ping folks on the general channel too. Will post the final Mail-OK CSV by Thu 5pm for one last pass. Thanks team! :sparkles:
